audience_scope.purpose: Universal audience gate. An item enters the pipeline only if its title/body concretely concerns the professions or learners below. Example: an ÖSYM KPSS announcement with no health-profession context is DISCARD.
rules: A generic term alone (KPSS, memur, personel alımı, burs, sınav takvimi) never qualifies; it needs a profession/learner term from physician, dental, veterinary or a named medical exam/pathway.
Weak terms (burs, exchange, Erasmus, language exams, licensing) qualify only together with a profession/learner term.

Audience-native sources (whose whole output targets this audience, or whose own include gate is health-topic-only such as TÜİK health bulletins) skip this gate but still pass their own include/exclude gate.
Nurses, pharmacists, allied-health-only and lay-consumer health items are out of scope unless the item explicitly concerns physicians, dentists, veterinarians or their students.

Health-system layer: for the listed official sources only, health-system terms admit an item directly (indirect physician impact; public/population health is not excluded for concerning the public). It never applies to audience-external sources or to consumer/lifestyle health.

healthSystemLayer.purpose: Items that indirectly affect physicians/dentists/veterinarians (health-system regulation, hospitals, pay/performance, SGK health practice, public-health measures). Allowed only from the listed official sources; enters the pipeline directly as ACCEPT (source default route) tagged health_system_indirect_impact; public/population health counts as indirect physician relevance. Consumer health, nurse/pharmacist-only, PR and advertising stay out.
